{"type":"tool_call_update","toolCallId":"call-938bb53c-ddfa-4c95-9d46-9112db1dd53c-27","status":"completed","content":[{"type":"content","content":{"type":"text","text":"Men’s Basketball Announces Schedule Change For Opening Night - Jacksonville University \n\n[Skip To Main Content](#main-content) Pause All Rotators \n\n![](https://dxbhsrqyrr690.cloudfront.net/sidearm.nextgen.sites/jacksonvilleuni.sidearmsports.com/images/responsive_2023/logo_main.png) \n\n ![Jacksonville Basketball banner update 2025](https://images.sidearmdev.com/convert?url=https%3a%2f%2fdxbhsrqyrr690.cloudfront.net%2fsidearm.nextgen.sites%2fjacksonvilleuni.sidearmsports.com%2fimages%2f2025%2f7%2f22%2fbasketball_7fTcK.png&type=webp) \n\n*   []()\n*   []()\n*   []()\n*   []()\n*   []()\n*   []()\n\n### Story Links\n\n**JACKSONVILLE, Fla. –** The Jacksonville University men's basketball team has announced a change of opponent for the team's opening night game.  \n  \n Previously, the Dolphins were scheduled to play Paine College on Monday, Nov. 2 but have changed opponents to Trinity College of Jacksonville. Tipoff time and date are still the same.  \n  \n Monday's game will still be streamed on ESPN+ and all season tickets and individual tickets still apply to the opening night contest.   \n  \n The Dolphins will now host Trinity College of Jacksonville twice this season, with the second game taking place inside Swisher Gymnasium on Saturday, Nov. 28 at 6 p.m.  \n  \n Jacksonville boasts an 11-0 record against TCJ all-time.  \n  \n Season tickets are still available for Jacksonville's 2026-27 season and can be purchased [HERE](https://tickets.judolphins.com/event-details/ju-mens-basketball-season-tickets-2026-27). Season tickets open the opportunity to purchase tickets to the exclusive Hoop Room gameday experience for all Division 1 home opponents. Hoop Room offers Dolphin fans complimentary food and drink and an opportunity to hear from JU basketball coaches about the upcoming game. \n\n*   []()\n*   []()\n*   []()\n*   []()\n*   []()\n*   []()\n\n### Story Links\n\n**JACKSONVILLE, Fla. –** The Jacksonville University men's basketball team has announced a change of opponent for the team's opening night game.  \n  \n Previously, the Dolphins were scheduled to play Paine College on Monday, Nov. 2 but have changed opponents to Trinity College of Jacksonville. Tipoff time and date are still the same.  \n  \n Monday's game will still be streamed on ESPN+ and all season tickets and individual tickets still apply to the opening night contest.   \n  \n The Dolphins will now host Trinity College of Jacksonville twice this season, with the second game taking place inside Swisher Gymnasium on Saturday, Nov. 28 at 6 p.m.  \n  \n Jacksonville boasts an 11-0 record against TCJ all-time.  \n  \n Season tickets are still available for Jacksonville's 2026-27 season and can be purchased [HERE](https://tickets.judolphins.com/event-details/ju-mens-basketball-season-tickets-2026-27). Season tickets open the opportunity to purchase tickets to the exclusive Hoop Room gameday experience for all Division 1 home opponents. Hoop Room offers Dolphin fans complimentary food and drink and an opportunity to hear from JU basketball coaches about the upcoming game. Hoop Room is also open during halftime.  \n  \n For more information about the Jacksonville men's basketball team, visit judolphins.com/sports/mens-basketball or follow the Dolphins on social media:
